blocks.text: Read the chapter with this setting in view: Greek and Latin Psalter traditions number many psalms differently from the Masoretic tradition because they combine Psalms 9-10 and 114-115, divide Psalms 116 and 147, and transmit Psalm 151 beyond the 150-psalm count. It gives a starting point for following the chapter's own movement. The chapter itself should determine how far the point is taken. A more precise reconstruction remains disputed.
